apply.title: Submit an application
apply.category_help: Choose a recruitment category. The backend derives the responsible agency from this choice.
apply.agency_derived: This category is handled by {{agency}}. You do not need to select or submit an agency.
apply.education_help: Enter the {{registry}} reference for this category. This is the only academic field the backend requires for the selected category.
apply.declaration_copy: I declare that the information I provide is true and accurate. This acknowledgement is local to this form; the backend submission contains only the supported category and academic reference fields.
apply.listen_declaration_hint: Listen to this declaration in Kinyarwanda.
apply.review_body: Submitting sends only the category and its required academic reference through the applicant session. The backend decides the application record and status.
apply.success_body: The backend accepted your application. Your current citizen application list has been refreshed; no application details are inferred from this response.
apply.replay_body: The backend replayed the earlier filing for this idempotency key. Your current citizen application list has been refreshed.
apply.validation_body: The backend rejected the submission fields or idempotency key. Review the form and try again.
apply.duplicate_body: The backend reports that you already have an application for this recruitment opportunity. Your application list is the source of truth.
apply.conflict_body: The backend cannot accept this submission in the current state.

conflicts.IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED: Your applicant identity must be verified before you submit.
conflicts.NO_OPEN_CAMPAIGN: There is no open recruitment campaign for this category.
conflicts.AGE_PENDING: Your age eligibility is still being checked.
conflicts.CROSS_AGENCY_ACCEPT_LOCK: This submission is blocked by an existing acceptance lock.
conflicts.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: The backend cannot accept this submission in its current state.

apply.offline_body: Your draft remains on this device. Filing requires a connection to the applicant edge; no submission was sent.
apply.dependency_title: A required service is temporarily unavailable
apply.dependency_body: The backend could not reach a required service. Your draft remains on this device; try again later.
apply.session_body: Your applicant session has ended or is not available. Sign in again before submitting.
apply.forbidden_body: The backend refused this session or its CSRF protection. Sign in again and try once more.
apply.rate_limit_body: Please wait before trying to submit again.
